session.title: Sabah family trip — travel and family activity only
session.purpose: Keep the Kota Kinabalu and Kundasang family trip family-first without manufacturing a workout to satisfy nominal weekly frequency.

dose.life_activity: Travel, walking, island activity, sightseeing and any family-selected hike are allowed as life load.
dose.hike_rule: If the sunrise hike occurs today, record it on Garmin and do not add another workout.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Consolidation plus normal travel activity preserves the preceding bike block better than forcing low-quality training around family logistics, sleep disruption and heat.
execution_rules: Do not chase steps, intensity minutes or a training-load target.
Use fluids, sodium, shade and food according to actual heat exposure and family logistics.
A substantive hike replaces training for the day.

expected_result.week: Family activity is absorbed without hidden training-density debt.

stop_rules: Illness, poor sleep, travel fatigue or heat symptoms remove optional hiking intensity and increase recovery attention.
